summary: This note is a short wiki-style biography of James Cottriall, an English musician born 1 January 1986 in Stratford upon Avon who lives in Los Angeles, California. It states that he became famous in Austria with his first single "Unbreakable", which spent twenty weeks in the Austrian top 40 in summer 2010 and was nominated for Song of the Year at the 2010 Amadeus Awards.
one_line: English musician James Cottriall, based in Los Angeles, known in Austria for his 2010 single "Unbreakable".
key_facts: James Cottriall was born on 1 January 1986 in Stratford upon Avon.
James Cottriall is an English musician.
James Cottriall is currently living in Los Angeles, California.
James Cottriall became famous throughout Austria with the success of his first single, "Unbreakable".
"Unbreakable" spent twenty weeks in the Austrian top 40 charts in summer 2010.
"Unbreakable" was nominated for the Song of the Year category at the 2010 Austrian music Amadeus Awards.
